name: Crime Rhyme 2
source:
A beautiful and popular girl who lives with her boyfriend becomes a toy for the students right at the school grounds. She endures this situation as she is tenderly loved at home by her boyfriend. However, more and more boys enter master-slave relations with her...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一个美丽而受欢迎的女孩与男友住在一起，成为校园里学生们的玩具。她忍受着这种情况，因为她在家里受到男友的温柔疼爱。然而，越来越多的男生与她建立了主奴关系……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
